claim: *Engineering capital across time and space.* A conceptual snapshot of three products shaped by successive engineering episodes. Within each product, useful engineering structure has accumulated selectively; the incomplete constellations represent neither a prescribed product model nor a maturity level. Across products, an assurance obligation connects all three, code-quality mechanisms are shared by two, and connections to a common security posture remain possible. Solid relationships are established; dotted relationships are emerging or possible.
topology:
A conceptual snapshot of three products shaped by successive engineering episodes. Each
    product is a softly bounded gray field holding a partial constellation of lifecycle surfaces around a central
    engineering-models node. Every relationship runs to the center of a named node so it plugs in cleanly: solid
    gray lines are established internal relationships, dotted gray lines are emerging or possible ones, and
    unconnected nodes are local. Three cross-product concerns connect to named nodes: an assurance obligation to
    Product 1 Assurance, Product 2 Engineering Models, and Product 3 Evidence; a code-quality mechanism to the
    Engineering Models of Products 1 and 2; and a security posture, dotted, to the Engineering Models of all three.
    No arrowheads, axes, or scale.
required_terms: Solid: established. Dotted: emerging / possible. Incomplete constellations are neither prescribed models nor maturity levels.
bw_encoding: Black text and strokes, white nodes; boundary weight indicates emphasis or enforcement. Original dashed semantics retained per figure; no color-only distinction.
